title: PredictionInput
description: SAIA-Class S prediction input representing the full state required for predictive governance forecasting within Beast System 3.0.

inputId.description: Unique identifier for this prediction input (UUID recommended).

caseId.description: ID of the case being evaluated.

actor.description: Snapshot of the actor context at prediction time.

environment.description: Snapshot of the environment context at prediction time.

wellbeingSignals.description: List of wellbeing signal objects or signal IDs relevant to the prediction.

recentEvents.description: List of recent governance or wellbeing events relevant to forecasting.

actionDescription.description: Natural-language description of the proposed or observed action being evaluated.

parameters.description: Optional model parameters or overrides for prediction tuning.
